name: cm-workspace
description: Change-management working tools: an RFP-to-proposal deck generator that plans a bid against the client's stated requirements and audits it for requirement coverage and content provenance, and a training-material generator that turns a functional specification document into a first-draft training deck — screenshots placed in context, native diagrams built from the spec's own logic, and knowledge-check questions derived from the spec — audited for objective/source coverage and content provenance the same way.
